# Grand Vue Apartments

> 55 luxury residences for rent in Olorien, Arusha, Tanzania. Furnished and unfurnished one, two and three-bedroom apartments. Swimming pool, gym, landscaped gardens, back-up power, borehole water, 24/7 security, views of Mt. Meru and Mt. Kilimanjaro.

Contact: +255 719 180 380 | info@grandvueapartments.com | WhatsApp https://wa.me/255719180380
Address: PPF AGM Building, Njiro, P.O. Box 421, Arusha, Tanzania
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/grandvueapartments/
